basics.name: Ahmed Mazen
basics.label: Digital Transformation and Cloud Architecture Leader
basics.summary: Principal Solution Architect and Enterprise Architect with 19+ years of enterprise experience across banking, fintech, telecom, government, education and IoT. A foundation in Java/Jakarta EE, IBM enterprise platforms and banking middleware, now designing secure, resilient integration ecosystems: payment integration, ESB and API architecture, Kafka event streaming and AWS platform networking, with hands-on engineering depth, architecture governance, high availability and disaster recovery.

work.name: Synechron
work.summary: Enterprise Java, cloud, platform engineering, cybersecurity and AI
highlights: Lead end-to-end enterprise architecture across Java/Spring, microservices, APIs and modern web applications.
Define application, data, process and infrastructure designs using TOGAF and C4 (L2/L3), including AWS, networking and capacity planning.
Govern architecture, security and the SDLC, guide cross-functional delivery, and integrate AI/ML capabilities for analytics and automation.

work.name: Independent consultant (client: Spectro Systems)
work.summary: IoT modernisation, payments integration, AWS platform networking and security, for UAE and European markets
highlights: Cloud platform and network architecture: modernised the SpectroTank platform as AWS cloud-native microservices, with VPC, VPC Lattice, PrivateLink, NLB/ALB and WAF connectivity, Istio mTLS and SPIFFE/SPIRE workload identity.
Fintech billing and payments: designed Stripe Billing and Payments API integrations for usage-based billing, pay-as-you-go pricing, automated payment processing and subscription lifecycle management.

Event-driven payment platforms: Kafka payment-streaming pipelines with MirrorMaker 2 and Schema Registry for transaction monitoring, fraud detection, anomaly identification and predictive risk scoring.
Governance and security controls: TOGAF ADM, C4 and PCI DSS 4.0; cardholder data environment boundaries and policy as code with OPA, Kyverno and OpenBao.

Delivery and resilience: GitOps and CI/CD with GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Argo CD and Argo Rollouts, with SBOM and vulnerability assessment; multi-region disaster recovery, Kubernetes backup and observability with Velero and OpenTelemetry.

work.name: NTG Clarity
highlights: Architected a distributed, multi-tier SNMP network-management and polling platform that collects infrastructure telemetry, aggregates operational metrics and supports near-real-time fault detection across carrier networks.
Defined availability, scalability and business-continuity standards, with service-level objectives and resilience requirements, for services processing millions of network transactions a day.
Established SDLC governance and engineering quality practices (TDD, automated testing, regression controls) to raise release confidence and reduce service-disruption risk.

Led API governance, edge security and full-stack development with Apache APISIX, Alibaba Cloud, React and Node.js to deliver scalable IoT analytics dashboards.
